name: Combined four ones
description: Each player rolls one opening die; reroll ties. The higher roll starts using both dice. Move all 15 checkers home and bear them off; doubles give four moves. Enter captured checkers from the bar first. Two opposing checkers block a point; a lone checker is hit. Use the maximum possible dice and the higher die if only one is usable. Undo a move only while your turn is unfinished. Choose a match goal of 1, 3, 5, 7, 11 or 15 points. A gammon scores double and a backgammon triple. If enabled, offer the doubling cube before rolling; the opponent may take or drop. The cube changes match points, never the platform token pot. First to the chosen goal wins.
